productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
This bundle includes:

Everything Under The Sun – Curious questions galore! A fascinating collection of facts and ideas to answer some of life's most quizzical queries.

Little Leaders: Exceptional Men in Black History – Discover the exceptional men who reached new heights in black history in this volume of the Little Leaders series.

Break the Mould – This award-winning book celebrates the power of being different and teaches the importance of believing in yourself.

Ladybird Audio Adventures: The Frozen World – Wrap up warm and jump into an icy adventure with this atmospheric audio story, packed with the sounds and creatures of the Arctic and Antarctica - brrrrr-illiant!

The Human Body: Organs – Shrink down with the BrainBots to learn all about organs. Did you know the human body has 78?

Biggest Ideas: Sir John Harington – Join the BrainBots as they travel back in time to meet Sir John Harington, inventor of the toilet.
productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Explore the polar regions, meet the inventor of the toilet and go inside the human body with the Brainbots and much more in this bundle of six incredible cards. This immersive learning bundle is tailored for children aged 5 and up._**

This bundle includes:  
  
Everything Under The Sun – Curious questions galore! A fascinating collection of facts and ideas to answer some of life's most quizzical queries.  
  
Little Leaders: Exceptional Men in Black History – Discover the exceptional men who reached new heights in black history in this volume of the Little Leaders series.  
  
Break the Mould – This award-winning book celebrates the power of being different and teaches the importance of believing in yourself.  
  
Ladybird Audio Adventures: The Frozen World – Wrap up warm and jump into an icy adventure with this atmospheric audio story, packed with the sounds and creatures of the Arctic and Antarctica - brrrrr-illiant!  
  
The Human Body: Organs – Shrink down with the BrainBots to learn all about organs. Did you know the human body has 78?  
  
Biggest Ideas: Sir John Harington – Join the BrainBots as they travel back in time to meet Sir John Harington, inventor of the toilet.
